source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseDmlObjectListEvidenceTest { @isTest static void objectRows() { Account one = new Account(Name = 'One'); Object oneObject = one; Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(oneObject); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); one.Name = 'One Updated'; System.assert(Database.update((Object) one).isSuccess()); one.Name = 'One Updated Again'; System.assert(Database.update((Object) one, false).isSuccess()); one.Name = 'One Updated System'; System.assert(Database.update((Object) one, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.delete((Object) one).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.undelete((Object) one).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.delete((Object) one, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); System.assert(Database.undelete((Object) one, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).isSuccess()); Account two = new Account(Name = 'Two'); Account three = new Account(Name = 'Three'); List<Object> records = new List<Object>{two, three}; List<Database.SaveResult> insertedList = Database.insert(records); System.assertEquals(2, insertedList.size()); two.Name = 'Two Updated'; three.Name = 'Three Updated'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.update(records).size()); two.Name = 'Two Updated Again'; three.Name = 'Three Updated Again'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.update(records, false).size()); two.Name = 'Two Updated System'; three.Name = 'Three Updated System'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.update(records, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); two.Name = 'Two Updated Both'; three.Name = 'Three Updated Both'; System.assertEquals(2, Database.update(records, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(records).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(records).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(records, false).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(records, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(records, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.undelete(records, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(2, Database.delete(records, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); } }
